name: ○hi Otona no Omochaya-san
source:
The main character is asked to work at his uncle's adult toy shop. He is surprised to see adult toys, piling all around the shop. "I will work hard for customers. Who is coming today? Many H customers?" He finds that many beautiful women come to the shop, sometimes boyfriend and girlfriend, husband and wife together. "Why don't you try this toy for your night life?"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305050140/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1005274]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公受托到叔父经营的成人用品店工作。看见店内堆得到处都是的成人玩具，他大吃一惊。“我要努力为顾客服务。今天会有什么人来？会有很多好色的客人吗？”他发现，许多美女都会光顾这里，有时情侣或夫妻也会一同前来。“不如试试这件玩具，为你们的夜生活增添乐趣？”

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305050140/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_45/products_id/1005274]Eroge Shop[/url]]
